'''Eaba N'Wan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He secretly stole copies of the Corporations's designs for the [[MMR-9]] recovery [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and gave them to the [[Fireclaw Horde]], a [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] criminal gang. He subsequently traveled to the Horde's hideout on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], and assisted the gang by helping create a modified version of the MMR-9, to use for attacking [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
